newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Aug 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Aug 6.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Household spending tumbles 4.7 percent in June.
-- Liberal Democratic Party survey shows 76 percent favour constitutional revision.
-- Government plans to introduce 'defence preparedness' system.
-- Deputy bureau chief level talks between Japan and North Korea to be postponed.
-- Poll shows 51 percent support food aid to North Korea.
